title: Forestry-waste biochar for oil sands process water
summary: Producing forestry-waste biochar and assessing its application in pilot-scale columns and constructed wetlands. Funded by the Canada First Research Excellence Fund.

title: Solar- and UV-driven photocatalysis
summary: Developing photocatalysts and photocatalytic reactors for water treatment.

title: Immobilized photocatalytic systems
summary: Immobilizing photocatalysts for integration into flow-through reactor modules.

title: Biochar & hydrochar for metals
summary: Designing carbon-based adsorbents for metal adsorption.

title: Biochar-supported Bi2WO6
summary: Synthesized and characterized biochar-based photocatalysts and studied structure–performance relationships in real water matrices.

title: Performance, toxicity & leaching
summary: Assessed contaminant removal, toxicity, and leaching potential; developed and validated HPLC methods.

title: Green hydrogen production
summary: Evaluated wind and solar energy integration with PEM and alkaline electrolysis for hydrogen production from saline water, including mass/energy balances and techno-economic assessment.

title: Optical microfluidics
summary: Fabricated microfluidic devices and colloidal semiconductor quantum wells for optical waveguides and solution lasers.

title: Organic solvent nanofiltration
summary: Fabricated cellulose membranes through alkaline hydrolysis of cellulose acetate and evaluated industrial wastewater applications.
